verdict.rationale: Asana's official MCP server and Asana app in Claude/ChatGPT let users ask natural-language questions and get answers, reports, and summaries drawn from their Asana workspace data, so the core Q&A over workspace content is documented. The answering AI, however, is the external assistant, and nothing shows answers come with citations back to source items. Asana Dash ('AI Chief of Staff') is named but not described as a Q&A feature. Missing for 10: documented citations or source links in answers, a native in-Asana ask-AI Q&A experience, and hands-on corroboration of answer quality or speed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask AI a question and get an instant answer with citations from my workspace content

citations.quote: Asana's official MCP server lets you interact with your Asana workspace through natural language—create tasks, search projects, analyze workload, and more—all from your preferred AI platform.
Generate reports and summaries based on Asana data
The Asana app in Claude brings your work graph directly into Claude conversations
Read tools return data from your workspace without making any changes.
